# Jungle Rent

> Real estate startup with dual mission: solving the student housing crisis and democratizing access to real estate investment in Turin, Italy.

## About

Jungle Rent S.r.l. is a certified **Start-up Innovativa** founded in October 2025. We acquire, renovate, and manage properties to rent to university students and tourists in Turin, serving 90,000+ students across 7 major institutions. Investment opportunities start from €100.

## Strike Emergency Directory ⭐ NEW

Interactive directory for transport strikes in Italy with emergency contacts, refund procedures, and alternatives.

- **URL IT**: https://junglerent.it/scioperi-italia
- **URL EN**: https://junglerent.it/italy-strikes
- **Emergency numbers**:
  - Trenitalia: 892021 (24/7) / 800 90 60 60 (free, disabled)
  - Italo: 892020 / 060708 (free for sales)
  - Trenord: 02.72.49.49.49 / Chat TREasy (free)
  - Enjoy car sharing: 800 900 505 (free 24/7)
  - Emergency: 112
- **Airlines**: ITA Airways 800 65 6555, Ryanair, EasyJet, Vueling, Lufthansa
- **Airports**: Fiumicino +39 06 6595 1, Malpensa +39 02 2340 0223
- **January 2026 strikes**:
  - Jan 9-10: National railway (Trenitalia, Italo, RFI, Trenord)
  - Jan 12-13: National school strike (FLP, CONALPE, CONFSAI, CSLE)
  - Jan 13: National taxi strike 24h (excl. Umbria) - Uri/itTaxi NOT participating
  - Jan 13: Busitalia Umbria, Minimetrò Perugia, Konecta Torino/Asti
  - Jan 15: ATM Milan 24h
  - Jan 20: National railway + TPL
  - Jan 29: Conerobus Ancona
  - Jan 30: RFI Bologna, Sicilia bus (Gallo, Giamporcaro, Sais)
- **February-March 2026**: Feb 16 (air), Mar 7 (air)
